data.name: Jaelion
data.gender_notes: Jaelion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaelion is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew word 'Yahweh Elion', meaning 'Mountain of God'. In the Bible, Jael is a woman who famously defeats the Canaanite general Sisera, leading to the Israelites' victory. The name Jaelion can be seen as a masculine form of Jael, and it carries the powerful symbolism of trusting in God and triumphing over adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes trust in God and triumph over adversity
data.etymology: Jaelion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaelion total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: יעליון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יעליון מורכב משורש יעל שפירושו גבוה או רם, והסיומת יון המרמזת על שייכות לאלוהים, ומשמעותו המלאה היא שאלוהים הוא הרם והגבוה, ובהקשר הנוצרי הוא מסמל את האמונה באלוהים כבורא ומושיע

in_greek.name: Ιαηλίον
in_greek.long_meaning: το όνομα Ιαηλίον προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές ρίζες της λέξης Ιαήλ, που σημαίνει υψηλός ή μεγαλοπρεπής, και το ελληνικό επίθημα -ίον, που δείχνει συσχέτιση με τον θεό, και η πλήρης σημασία του είναι ότι ο θεός είναι ο υψηλός και ο μεγαλοπρεπής, και στον χριστιανικό контέκست συμβολίζει την πίστη στον θεό ως δημιουργό και σωτήρα

in_latin.name: Jaelion
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Jaelion constat ex radicibus hebraicis verbi Jael, quod significat altus vel sublimis, et suffixo -ion, quod indicat relationem cum deo, et significatio plena est quod deus est altus et sublimis, et in contextu christiano significat fidem in deum ut creatorem et salvatorem

in_english.name: Jaelion
in_english.long_meaning: the name Jaelion is derived from Hebrew roots of the word Jael, meaning high or exalted, and the suffix -ion, indicating a relationship with God, and the full meaning is that God is the high and exalted one, and in Christian context it symbolizes faith in God as creator and savior, representing spiritual growth and divine guidance
